_comment: Additional models for Changjutsu V8 (open-weights branch: FLUX 3 Klein identity frame + LTX-2.3 motion). 'directory' is relative to ComfyUI/models. FLUX 3 Klein files are on a GATED repo: accept the FLUX Kommunity licence at https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy once, then download logged in (hf CLI or browser). All LTX files are ungated.

models.name: flux3-image-klein-int8-convrot.safetensors
models.used_by: FLUX 3 Klein (step-distilled) — multi-reference first-frame character swap

models.name: qwen3vl_4b_int8_convrot.safetensors
models.used_by: FLUX 3 Klein text encoder (CLIPLoader type flux3)

models.name: ltx-2.3-22b-distilled_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled_v3.safetensors
models.used_by: LTX-2.3 22B distilled, fp8 (transformer only) — core video model of the open-weights branch

models.name: LTX23_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors
models.used_by: LTX-2.3 audio VAE (LTX generates audio; we re-mux original anyway)

models.name: ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.1.safetensors
models.optional: only if the 2-pass upscale stage is enabled

models.name: ltx-2.3-22b-ic-lora-union-control-ref0.5.safetensors
models.used_by: IC-LoRA: pose / depth / canny control video → motion transfer

models.name: ltx-2.3-22b-ic-lora-ingredients-0.9.safetensors
models.used_by: IC-LoRA: Ingredients — identity from a reference sheet of the character stills (route B, A/B against the FLUX first-frame route)

node_packs.name: ComfyUI-LTXVideo
node_packs.note: Core ComfyUI has LTXVImgToVideo*, LTXVConditioning etc.; the IC-LoRA guide nodes come from this pack.
